summary: Iteration 7 tested 3 new features — (A) Chat message reactions (❤️ 👍 😂 🎉 😮) with toggle + per-user + persistence, (B) Trip Itinerary day-grouped CRUD with creator/organizer permissions and delete-cascade, (C) Recap WhatsApp share button. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_features.py — 10/10 pytest tests PASS (125s). Covers reactions toggle add/remove, two users different emojis, same emoji stacked count, GET messages includes reactions map keyed by emoji → user_id list; unsupported 🦄 → 400; malformed message id → 400/404; well-formed non-existent ObjectId → 404; non-member (trip with no other members) reacting → 403; itinerary POST returns member_name+created_by+id; list sorted by date then time (Arrive 09:00 → Lunch 13:00 → Rohtang 10:00 next-day → Return no-time next-day); bad date 'tomorrow' → 400 with 'YYYY-MM-DD' message; bad time '25:99' → 400; empty title → 422; PUT/DELETE by non-creator non-organizer → 403; creator can edit/delete own; organizer can edit/delete anyone's; DELETE /api/trips/{id} cascade also empties itinerary_items collection for that trip_id. Frontend Playwright (as aarav organizer + meera member on fixture trip TEST_Iter7 6a6b3456bb69166a0bac066e): trip-tab-itinerary between Balances and Chat renders 3 day sections itinerary-day-2026-09-0[1..3] ✓; itinerary-add-btn opens itinerary-dialog with title/date-select/time/place/notes inputs; submitting adds itinerary-item card ✓; per-day '+ add here' link itinerary-day-add-2026-09-01 pre-selects 'Day 1 · Tue, Sep 1' in date-select and the new item lands under that day section ✓; itinerary-edit-btn opens dialog with prefilled fields, edit persists ✓; itinerary-delete-btn removes item after browser confirm ✓. Chat: reaction-picker appears on bubble hover (.group\/msg > div inside [data-testid=trip-chat-message]) ✓; clicking react-btn-❤️ adds reaction-chip '❤️ 1' ✓; when meera adds 👍 a second chip appears; when meera also ❤️, chip becomes '❤️ 2'; clicking chip toggles off own reaction → '❤️ 1' ✓; reactions persist after full page reload ✓. Recap: recap-whatsapp-btn (green circle) visible in footer next to download btn ✓; clicking opens popup to https://wa.me/?text=... which WhatsApp redirects to https://api.whatsapp.com/send/?text=... — decoded text contains full share URL {origin}/api/recap/{token}/share ✓. Permission enforcement in UI: on aarav-created items meera sees NO edit/delete buttons; on her own itinerary item she DOES see both (confirmed by DB check that created_by == meera on the one item where buttons appeared) ✓. Regression: chat send + Expenses/Balances tabs open without errors, recap download menu still present, invite code visible.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers_trips.py react_message stores reactions as a plain dict on the message document; concurrent reacts from two users may last-write-wins because the read-modify-write is NOT atomic. Consider using $addToSet / $pull with $exists so toggles are atomic (e.g., first attempt $addToSet reactions.emoji=uid; if modifiedCount==0 then $pull). Under low chat concurrency this is unlikely to bite but is a race by construction.

backend/routers_trips.py ALLOWED_REACTIONS uses the U+2764 U+FE0F ❤️ variant-selector sequence; some clients (older Android, some emoji fonts) send U+2764 without VS16 and will be rejected as 'Unsupported reaction'. Consider normalizing incoming emoji (strip VS16) or accepting both forms.

backend/routers_trips.py get_itinerary_item_or_404 returns 400 'Invalid item id' for any ObjectId() ctor exception — same code path also swallows real DB errors as 400. Prefer catching only bson InvalidId.

frontend/src/pages/RecapPage.jsx shareWhatsApp: window.open('https://wa.me/?text=...', '_blank', 'noopener') — some mobile browsers/pop-up blockers require an explicit user-gesture-scoped window.open call BEFORE await. Currently OK because shareWhatsApp is synchronous, but if you later prefix any await (e.g., fetching a fresh share token) the popup will be blocked. Consider opening a blank window synchronously and setting .location afterward.

frontend/src/components/TripChat.jsx reaction-picker uses group-hover/msg on the message row; on touch devices there is no hover, so reactions are unreachable. Consider a long-press or tap-to-show fallback.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (itinerary CRUD via dialog + per-day add link + edit/delete visibility per role, chat reactions add/toggle/cross-user/persist-after-reload, WhatsApp popup URL, regression on Expenses/Balances tabs)

Frontend playwright used the pre-existing fixture trip TEST_Iter7 (6a6b3456bb69166a0bac066e) as instructed; it left behind 2 residue itinerary items (UI_Item_1567 by aarav, UI_Edited_9866 by meera — the latter was originally an aarav-created fixture item that aarav (organizer) edited, which correctly preserved created_by=meera showing edit did not clobber creator field). Main agent may clean up as noted.

rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found in the 3 new features. Code-review observations captured under critical_code_review_comments are all forward-looking hardening (atomic reactions, VS16 emoji normalization, touch-device reaction affordance, popup-blocker safety on shareWhatsApp).
